cover_headline: Anthropic's Record $81.3 Billion IPO Opens 34% Higher, Then Fades to a 17% Gain
facts: Anthropic sold 980 million shares at $83 each, raising $81.3 billion, surpassing the $75 billion SpaceX collected at its June listing
Shares opened at $111.50, 34% above the $83 IPO price, and closed at $97.17, up 17% on the day
At the opening price, Anthropic's fully diluted valuation reached about $2 trillion

end.headline: Anthropic's Record $81.3 Billion IPO Opens 34% Higher, Then Fades to a 17% Gain
end.line: The Claude maker's Nasdaq debut briefly valued it at about $2 trillion on a fully diluted basis, surpassing SpaceX's listing as the largest IPO on record.

quote.text: Debt is an instrument that we have available to us, and we'd like to use at some point in the future.
quote.speaker: Dario Amodei
